caption: The drawing features a glass or ceramic pedestal stand, rendered primarily in shades of blue and white, against a beige or cream background. The central object is composed of a broad, round base that supports a fluted stem adorned with ornate floral and geometric patterns. Atop the stem sits a thick, circular plate, depicted in cross-section as a half-circle, which displays additional embossed designs including flowers, leaves, and radiating linear segments. The plate has a slight edge or rim, with the words "Design on Top" written at its midpoint. The whole composition is centered on the page, with no other objects or background elements present. The drawing style emphasizes the texture and reflective qualities of the material, with visible shading and highlights, and the artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Cake Plate
